items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: I think Carrie Fritz was the, I think Carrie was the cornet player... Amos White was playing the cornet... manual on the piano.

ctx.x: Who was in the band? Who else?

Well, now I see, there was Manuel Mineta and there was, um, I can't, I can't, I think, I think Carrie Fritz was the, I think Carrie was the cornet player. And, um, they had a cornet, I think banjo or guitar, I'm not sure, I can't remember so well. But, um, I think there was a piano, either banjo or a guitar, cornet, Amos White was playing the cornet. He's now in Oakland, California, Amos White, cornet player. He was cornet and they had drums and trombone and manual on the piano.
